headline: Flight 19 vanishes off Florida
post_facts: A search plane was lost too

scenes.text: [solemnly] On this day, in nineteen forty-five... five Navy planes vanished off Florida.

scenes.label: Fort Lauderdale, Florida
scenes.caption: Navy Avenger torpedo bombers in formation
scenes.text: [calmly] Flight nineteen left Fort Lauderdale on a training flight, with fourteen airmen aboard.

scenes.label: Lt. Charles C. Taylor
scenes.caption: Flight leader of Flight 19
scenes.text: [gravely] Its leader's compasses failed... and the planes were lost at sea.

scenes.label: men lost, including a search plane crew of 13
scenes.text: [softly] A search plane with thirteen men went looking for them. It was lost too.

scenes.title: No wreckage ever found
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] No wreckage was ever found. It helped create the Bermuda Triangle legend.
